snippet.title: Slice & Dice - The Most Chaotic Pizza Simulator [Release Date Announcement]
snippet.description:
Steam Page:
Slice & Dice: Pizza Survival


After a year of Development, I am so excited to finally share that Slice & Dice: Pizza Survival will release on October 22nd, 2025! If this is the first time you've heard about the game or if you've been here before....HELLO!
 Im Eric, the Solo Developer of Slice & Dice: Pizza Survival, a post-apocalyptic business simulator with an  action-adventure twist! 

LORE:
The year is 2098 and the culinary landscape has gone off the deep end.After the Great Gluten Panic of 2072, most people in New City turned their backs on real food entirely, replacing meals with nutrient pods and synthetic flavor cartridges.
Pizza, once a symbol of warmth is now labeled “marinara paraphernalia"& opening up a Za shop is about as dangerous as smuggling contraband cheese.
But one man didn’t get the memo.

Meet Mario Meatballs
Armed with nothing but a dream and a rolling pin, Mario sets up shop where the neon lights fade...on the outskirts of New City.
By day, he slings piping-hot pies and questionable hamburgers to the few brave souls who still crave the taste of something real.
By night, he defends his shop against waves of Carb-Free Crusaders, Health Enforcers, and other diet-less driven fanatics determined to snuff out his saucy rebellion.
In a world that’s lost its taste, Mario Meatballs is serving up resistance one doughy, sauce-splattered slice at a time.
 Make sure to add it to your Wishlist and be the first to know when it launches on October 22nd.
